response.overview: “Filmmaking is one medium which is heavily dependent on mechanical devices–camera, editor, splicer, projector, etc. The printer is, perhaps, one of the most important machines in that it finalizes and reproduces our work. I learned to operate a Model C contact printer, which is a standard tool of the industry, and one which quickly became the independent filmmaker’s best friend. I got to know the printer well and it got to know me well, so I decided to collaborate with it to make a film. Even though machines never make art, I let the printer choose some of its own colors for the image I shot and edited. The printer understood my feelings about mechanical beauty and gave me some of the colors. I haven’t found out what the printer thinks about this piece yet.”
response.title: Timing Tape Twice
